bash.name: SHIELD BASH
bash.desc: SLAM YOUR SHIELD INTO A FOE: DAMAGE, KNOCKBACK AND A 1S STUN.

taunt.name: TAUNT
taunt.desc: EVERY ENEMY NEARBY ATTACKS BRANN FOR 4S. HE TAKES HALF DAMAGE MEANWHILE.

charge.name: CHARGE
charge.desc: DASH TO A FOE, KNOCKING ASIDE EVERYTHING IN THE WAY.

shieldwall.name: SHIELD WALL
shieldwall.desc: BLOCK 80% OF DAMAGE FOR 3S AND REFLECT ARROWS.

earthsplitter.name: EARTHSPLITTER
earthsplitter.desc: SLAM A LINE OF SHOCKWAVES AHEAD THAT STAGGERS FOES.

retribution.name: RETRIBUTION
retribution.desc: TAKING A HIT CUTS SHIELD BASH'S COOLDOWN BY 0.5S.

laststand.name: LAST STAND
laststand.desc: ONCE PER FIGHT, A LETHAL HIT LEAVES YOU AT 1 HP, INVULNERABLE FOR 3S.

bulwark.name: BULWARK
bulwark.desc: SHIELDS THE WHOLE PARTY AND TAUNTS EVERYTHING NEARBY.

fireball.name: FIREBALL
fireball.desc: A BOLT THAT BURSTS IN A SMALL AREA AND BURNS.

frostnova.name: FROST NOVA
frostnova.desc: A RING OF FROST AROUND PIP: DAMAGE AND 2 CHILL STACKS.

chain.name: CHAIN LIGHTNING
chain.desc: LIGHTNING THAT JUMPS BETWEEN UP TO 4 FOES.

blink.name: BLINK
blink.desc: TELEPORT AWAY FROM DANGER, LEAVING A DECOY FOR 2S.

barrage.name: ARCANE BARRAGE
barrage.desc: SIX HOMING MISSILES SPREAD ACROSS NEARBY FOES.

surge.name: ELEMENTAL SURGE
surge.desc: FOR 6S EVERY SPELL BURNS, CHILLS AND SHOCKS.

attunement.name: ATTUNEMENT
attunement.desc: STATUSES PIP APPLIES LAST 50% LONGER (+10% PER RANK).

studious.name: STUDIOUS
studious.desc: SPELL CRITS CUT 1S OFF YOUR LONGEST COOLDOWN.

wardweave.name: WARDWEAVE
wardweave.desc: -20% DAMAGE TAKEN FROM ARROWS AND SPELLS.

meteor.name: METEOR
meteor.desc: CALLS DOWN A METEOR ON A CLUSTER OF FOES.

step.name: SHADOW STEP
step.desc: BLINK BEHIND A FOE. YOUR NEXT HIT CRITS.

fan.name: FAN OF KNIVES
fan.desc: A RING OF THROWN BLADES AROUND SABLE.

smoke.name: SMOKE BOMB
smoke.desc: FOES IN THE CLOUD MISS HALF THEIR ATTACKS. SABLE VANISHES FOR 2S.

riposte.name: RIPOSTE
riposte.desc: PARRY THE NEXT HIT WITHIN 0.6S AND COUNTER WITH A GUARANTEED CRIT.

deathmark.name: DEATH MARK
deathmark.desc: MARKED FOE TAKES +25% FROM THE PARTY. IF IT DIES, THE COOLDOWN RESETS.

lightfingers.name: LIGHT FINGERS
lightfingers.desc: 15% CHANCE OF BONUS GOLD THE FIRST TIME YOU HIT A FOE.

thousand_cuts.name: THOUSAND CUTS
thousand_cuts.desc: BLINKS BETWEEN UP TO SIX FOES, CRITTING EACH.

mend.name: MEND
mend.desc: HEALS NEARBY ALLIES AND REVIVES THE DOWNED. (CLERIC DISCIPLINE)
